correctness.rationale: The first-order rare-entrance path coefficients were reconstructed from the two-state stationary path law and give the stated exact energy and variance coefficients. Substituting \(s=\rho^2\), \(x=(1-\varepsilon)/\rho\), and infinite-tail geometric sums, an independent symbolic expansion in \(h=n^{-1/4}\) gives exactly \(1/4+h[A/4+1/(8B)+B/(2A^2)]+O(h^2)\). The finite tails are exponentially small in \(n^{1/4}\), and \(u_n=e^{-n^2}\) makes multi-entrance and normalization corrections super-algebraically smaller than the displayed orders. Elementary minimization of \(C(A,B)\) gives the claimed unique optimum.
